prompts.park: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate a photorealistic wide landscape photograph for the Ukrainian 3D hide-and-seek game Хованки, no text. A spacious peaceful park at late afternoon: real mature trees with rough textured bark, a weathered wooden park bench close enough to see wood grain, natural mossy rocks, layered green hedges with hidden alcoves, a winding pale gravel path leading into a sunlit forest. Eye-level 35mm photography, believable scale, natural imperfections, rich but realistic green foliage, warm sunlight and detailed soft shadows. Crisp physical materials, no illustration, no cartoon, no people, no logos, no UI. This will be a full-width game menu background, keep the image readable behind a dark text overlay.
prompts.wood: Use case: photorealistic-natural. A square seamless tileable PBR albedo texture photograph of weathered warm natural oak wood planks for wooden benches, cabins and school desks in a realistic 3D hide-and-seek game. Straight-on orthographic surface only, frame entirely filled, fine realistic grain, subtle knots, worn pores and small scratches, parallel vertical boards. Neutral diffuse illumination, no cast shadows, no highlights baked in, no perspective, no text, no objects, no borders. Muted tan medium-light tones. Opposite edges should match for repeating.
prompts.bark: Use case: photorealistic-natural. A square seamless tileable PBR albedo texture photograph of realistic old oak tree bark for tree trunks in a 3D forest. Straight-on orthographic surface filling entire frame, deep natural irregular vertical fissures, layered rough grey brown bark, small traces of moss. Neutral diffuse illumination with no directional cast shadows, no perspective, no tree silhouette, no sky, no text, no borders. Opposite edges should match for repeating.
prompts.stone: Use case: photorealistic-natural. A square seamless tileable PBR albedo texture photograph of natural grey granite stone for rocks and stone surfaces in a realistic 3D hide-and-seek game. Flat orthographic close-up surface only, entire frame filled, fine mineral grains, natural cracks and subtle weathering. Neutral diffuse illumination, no cast shadows, no perspective, no objects, no text, no borders. Medium-light warm grey. Opposite edges should match for repeating.
